sql_definitions.sql:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users (
                    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                    username TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL COLLATE NOCASE,
                    email TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL COLLATE NOCASE,
                    password_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
                    salt TEXT NOT NULL,
                    display_name TEXT NOT NULL,
                    club_name TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Como 1907 (Original)',
                    club_short_name TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'COMO',
                    coins INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
                    cash_balance_cents INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 25000000000,
                    unread_notifications INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
                    failed_login_attempts INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
                    lockout_until INTEGER DEFAULT NULL,
                    created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
                    last_login_at INTEGER DEFAULT NULL
                );

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS otps (
                    email TEXT PRIMARY KEY COLLATE NOCASE,
                    code TEXT NOT NULL,
                    expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
                    attempts INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
                    created_at INTEGER NOT NULL
                );

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sessions (
                    token TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                    refresh_token TEXT,
                    user_id TEXT NOT NULL,
                    device_id TEXT DEFAULT 'Android Client',
                    ip_address TEXT DEFAULT '127.0.0.1',
                    created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
                    expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
                    refresh_expires_at INTEGER,
                    FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
                );

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS leagues (
                    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                    name TEXT NOT NULL,
                    invite_code TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL COLLATE NOCASE,
                    creator_id TEXT NOT NULL,
                    team_count INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(team_count IN (8, 10, 16, 20)),
                    status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PRE_SEASON' CHECK(status IN ('PRE_SEASON', 'ACTIVE', 'COMPLETED')),
                    preseason_ends_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
                    current_matchday INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
                    total_matchdays INTEGER NOT NULL,
                    created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
                    FOREIGN KEY (creator_id) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
                );

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS league_teams (
                    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                    league_id TEXT NOT NULL,
                    team_name TEXT NOT NULL,
                    team_short_name TEXT NOT NULL,
                    logo_url TEXT DEFAULT '',
                    rating INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 75,
                    manager_id TEXT DEFAULT NULL,
                    manager_name TEXT DEFAULT NULL,
                    is_bot INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
                    played INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
                    won INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
                    drawn INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
                    lost INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
                    goals_for INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
                    goals_against INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
                    goal_diff INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
                    points INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
                    bot_wins_against_user INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
                    created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
                    FOREIGN KEY (league_id) REFERENCES leagues (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
                    FOREIGN KEY (manager_id) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE SET NULL
                );

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS career_slots (
                    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                    user_id TEXT NOT NULL,
                    slot_number INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(slot_number BETWEEN 1 AND 6),
                    status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'EMPTY' CHECK(status IN ('EMPTY', 'ACTIVE')),
                    league_id TEXT DEFAULT NULL,
                    team_id TEXT DEFAULT NULL,
                    joined_at INTEGER DEFAULT NULL,
                    FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
                    FOREIGN KEY (league_id) REFERENCES leagues (id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
                    FOREIGN KEY (team_id) REFERENCES league_teams (id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
                    UNIQUE(user_id, slot_number)
                );

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS fixtures (
                    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                    league_id TEXT NOT NULL,
                    matchday INTEGER NOT NULL,
                    home_team_id TEXT NOT NULL,
                    away_team_id TEXT NOT NULL,
                    home_score INTEGER DEFAULT NULL,
                    away_score INTEGER DEFAULT NULL,
                    is_played INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
                    played_at INTEGER DEFAULT NULL,
                    FOREIGN KEY (league_id) REFERENCES leagues (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
                    FOREIGN KEY (home_team_id) REFERENCES league_teams (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
                    FOREIGN KEY (away_team_id) REFERENCES league_teams (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
                );

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS leagues (
                    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,

                    team_count INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(team_count IN (8, 10, 16, 20)),

                    preseason_ends_at INTEGER NOT NULL,

                );
